bank_name: South Bangla Agriculture & Commerce Bank PLC
period_note: SOUTH BANGLA AGRICULTURE AND COMMERCE BANK LIMITED (pre-2023 name). SOLO/STANDALONE basis, unaudited. Balance sheet is the 30-September-2020 period-end snapshot (reported), compared against 31-December-2019 (audited). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2020. BONUS SHARE ISSUE FOUND: paid-up capital rose from 6,224,050,160 (30-Jun-2020) to 6,846,455,170 here -- a 10% bonus issue (6,224,050,160 x 1.10 = 6,846,455,176, matching this bank's own documented dividend history, '10% in 2019-for-2020-issue'). Total assets (84,585,620,430), total liabilities (75,530,255,038) and total equity (9,055,365,392, confirmed both ways exactly) all reconcile; this quarter's equity format MERGES 'Current year's profit' into a single 'Surplus in profit and loss account' line (only four non-zero components, vs five/six in adjacent quarters), still summing exactly. FIRST NAV-PER-SHARE DISCLOSURE FOUND in this vintage (2017-2020): this filing prints 'Net asset value per share (NAV)' of 13.23 for 30-Sep-2020 (= 9,055,365,392/684,645,517 shares, exact) and 12.22 for the 31-Dec-2019 comparative -- the LATTER uses the CURRENT (30-Sep-2020) share count as its denominator (8,362,961,789/684,645,517=12.22), not Dec-2019's own historical share count, the same BAS-33-style restatement-on-enlarged-share-count mechanism this dataset has already documented extensively for EPS and occasionally NAV in this bank's annual reports. FORMAT CHANGE: unlike Q1/Q2-2020 (and all of 2017-2019), this filing's own EPS line is labelled plainly 'Earnings per share (EPS)' -- WITHOUT '(Annualized)' -- and its printed value of 0.99 matches the NON-annualized calculation (675,150,458/684,645,517=0.9861, rounding to 0.99) rather than an x4/3-annualized figure (which would be ~1.31); this is the first quarter in this bank's archive to adopt the plain-EPS convention later used throughout FY2023-2025, so eps_cumulative below is taken directly from the filing without back-derivation. No classified-loans/NPL, provision or capital-adequacy (CRAR/RWA/Tier1/Tier2) disclosure in this filing -- recorded as a gap, consistent with the rest of this vintage.
